title: hieracium hypochoeroides subsp. serinense
intro: Hieracium hypochoeroides subsp. serinense, commonly known as a species of hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium hypochoeroides subsp. serinense include its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and serve as an anti-cancer agent. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
